snippet.title: MindsEye - Official Launch Trailer | 2025
snippet.description:
Steam Pre-Order: https://go.mindseye.game/steam
PlayStation Pre-Order: https://go.mindseye.game/playstation 
Xbox Pre-Order: https://go.mindseye.game/xbox 

A thrilling new trailer dropped during Summer Game Fest, showcasing heart-pounding combat, a gripping near-future world, and the emotional journey of protagonist Jacob Diaz. 

Culminating in a jaw-dropping reveal: the legendary Agent 47 from IO Interactive’s Hitman franchise will join MindsEye as a playable character in a post-launch MindsEye x Hitman collaboration mission, set to launch in July 2025.

The MindsEye x Hitman mission is crafted using Build A Rocket Boy’s revolutionary Game Creation System, a powerful and intuitive system empowering players and crafters alike to design custom games, weave new narratives, and create entirely original experiences. This collaboration promises to blend MindsEye’s immersive storytelling with Agent 47’s signature stealth and precision, delivering an unforgettable crossover for fans.

MindsEye is launching June 10, 2025. Pre-orders are open now, with the Deluxe Edition Upgrade offering exclusive in-game content, including unique cosmetics and early access to select features. Secure your copy today and prepare to dive into a world of action, intrigue, and limitless creativity.

For more information, visit mindseye.game or follow @MindsEyeGame on social media
